nodes.label: Logo Dark (SVG)
nodes.description: Dark-theme SVG logo for Ordermatrix. Viewport 920x220. Composed of: (1) a circular border in off-white/cream (#F4F1EB, radius 92, stroke-only) centered at (110,110); (2) an 8-dot grid inside the circle arranged in a 3x3 matrix pattern minus one corner, all in #F4F1EB at radius 7 — representing the 'matrix' concept; (3) one accent dot at position (148,72) in coral/orange (#EC6240) at radius 11 — top-right of the grid, the highlighted/focal element; (4) the wordmark 'ordermatrix' in Bricolage Grotesque 600 weight, size 108, fill #F4F1EB, letter-spacing -3.5, positioned to the right of the icon. Color palette: off-white cream (#F4F1EB) on implied dark background, accent coral/orange (#EC6240). Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque (wordmark), DM Sans (loaded but not used in this file).
